sentences.text: 1. In spite of service of notice of this application for suspension of sentence, nobody appears for the victim/de facto complainant.

2. The applicant was convicted under Sections 376(2)(f)/376D/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 and was sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment of 20 years.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He prays for suspension of sentence.

3. Learned Counsel for the applicant says that the applicant stands on the same footing as Susanta Mana who was granted bail by this Court on December 15, 2025, passed in IA No: CRAN/1/2025 filed in c/w CRA(DB)/371/2024.

4. Learned State Counsel, while opposing the prayer for suspension of sentence, in his usual fairness, does not dispute that the present applicant and the said Susanta Mana are similarly circumstanced insofar as their roles in the alleged crime are concerned.
5. Hence, on the ground of parity, we allow this application and we hereby do suspend the sentence of imprisonment of the present applicant.

6. It is thus ORDERED that the applicant, namely, LALIT MANA shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand), with two sureties of like amount each,
one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Judge, Special Court under POCSO Act at Paschim Medinipur subject to condition that the applicant, while on bail, shall meet the Inspector-in- Charge/Officer-in-Charge of the jurisdictional Police Station, where he will be presently residing, once in a month till disposal of the appeal and he shall not enter the territorial jurisdiction of Salboni Police Station, Paschim Medinipur, until further orders and that the applicant shall be personally present or be represented by his learned Counsel during hearing of the appeal and he will surrender before the Trial Court as and when called for in connection with the present appeal.
7. The operation of the order of conviction and sentence shall remain suspended till disposal of the appeal or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

8. The department is directed to forward a copy of this order to the Superintendent of the concerned Correctional Home for immediate release of the present applicant/appellant unless he is wanted in connection with any other case.

9. We clarify that the observations made by us in this order are only for the purpose of disposing of the application for suspension of sentence and the same shall have no relevance at the final hearing of the appeal.
10. The application being IA No: CRAN/2/2026 is accordingly disposed of.
11. Criminal Section is directed to make available certified copies of this order to the parties, if applied for, upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
(Apurba Sinha Ray, J.)

(Arijit Banerjee,
